Subject: Growing scope — adding 5 product teams and procurement next steps

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was very excited about the latency and cost numbers. We want to move quicker than anticipated: leadership approved expanding our contract to cover five additional product teams (Search, Recommendations, Docs, Mobile Chat, and Support Triaging).

High level asks:
- Can you confirm how quickly we can provision separate API keys and dedicated projects for each team?
- Do we need any amendments to the SOW or order form to reflect the added teams and committed capacity?
- Expected timeline for staging -> prod rollout for all five teams (we have an internal target: full prod access by end of Q4).

Please loop in whoever on your side owns provisioning and contracts. We also want the account team to propose any recommended capacity or commitment changes — teams will start with low traffic but expected to scale after launch.

Appreciate a quick plan and next steps.

Best,
Elena
Head of Platform Engineering
StellarDevs

Elena — thanks, and congrats on the green light. High level response below; I included Rishi (account exec) and Connor (solutions) to drive provisioning and the rollout plan, and Marissa from CS for post-launch adoption.

Quick answers:
1) API keys & projects: We can spin up separate projects and keys for each team within 48–72 business hours after the signed amendment. Staging projects are created in parallel; keys for staging + prod are issued together.
2) Contracts/SOW: The SOW needs an amendment to reflect the additional team count and any committed capacity changes. If they keep a similar per-team usage profile we can do a simple addendum; if they want a single committed throughput for the account (preferred for discounts) we'll propose a commitment tier and corresponding unit price.
3) Timeline: Proposed phased rollout (also attached as a working sheet):
   - Week 1: AMS & Networking checklist, staging projects created (Connor leads)
   - Weeks 2–3: Team-by-team integration, smoke tests, canary routes for Search + Mobile Chat
   - Week 4: Gradual prod cutovers for 2 teams, monitor; remaining 3 teams roll in over next 4 weeks

Action items for StellarDevs:
- Sign amendment / execute DocuSign for the team addendum (we can provide two pricing options: per-team add-on vs account commitment).
- Provide a primary technical contact per team for key rotation and CIDR/VPC requirements.

I attached a draft SOW addendum and a rollout timeline. Connor — can you confirm staging infra checklist and estimate for provisioning? Rishi — can you prep the two pricing options?

Thanks,
Hannah
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Stellar_Onboard_SOW_v2.pdf, rollout_timeline.xlsx

Elena/Hannah — quick technical note from provisioning side. We can pre-provision 5 staging projects today (no contract required) so your engineers can begin integration and end-to-end tests. Production keys and guaranteed capacity will await the signed amendment for audit and billing alignment.

A few details to smooth the process:
- We'll create per-team projects named stellar-search, stellar-recs, stellar-docs, stellar-mobilechat, stellar-support. Each gets two API keys (staging/prod) on issuance.
- Default quota for initial provisioning: 500k tokens/month per team in staging. If any team expects bursty traffic (Search or Mobile Chat), flag that now so we can pre-configure autoscaling rules.
- Network: If you need VPC peering, send the CIDR blocks and contact for firewall exemptions; that typically adds 3–5 business days to networking setup.

I'll run the staging creation once I get the go-ahead from Elena. Dev — pairing for the CIDR/VPC items?

—Connor

Elena — I put together two pricing options attached: 1) Per-team add-on (no long-term commitment) and 2) Account-level commitment (6 or 12 month tiers) that includes a 12% discount over the per-team list price. For this scale, the account commitment gives the best unit economics and predictable throughput.

If StellarDevs is willing to commit to a 6-month baseline equal to 3x the estimated initial usage across the five teams, I can extend a one-time onboarding credit (applied to month 1) and waive the SOW change fee. If you prefer the per-team approach we can proceed with a faster amendment but fewer discounts.

Let me know which path you prefer and I can prepare the formal redline and DocuSign.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_options_stellardevs.pdf
